title: Multi-Order Batches and Wrong-Address Dispute Credits (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
A shopper juggling several orders on one batch has more addresses to keep apart; wrong-address disputes on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts reflect this through the orders the batch carried, as its record in Cartwise Shopper Batches shows.

**Rule.** The route credit and the unreachable-customer credit are added, and that sum is then adjusted by the orders the batch carried: on a batch of three or more orders it is doubled; on a batch of two orders it is increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point; on a single-order batch it is used as it stands.

## Adjustment by orders on the batch

| Orders on the batch | Route and unreachable-customer sum |
|---|---|
| Three or more | Doubled |
| Two | Increased by half of itself, the half rounded up to a whole point |
| One | Used as it stands |

## Worked sums (hypothetical)

| Sum before adjustment | Three or more orders | Two orders | One order |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 points | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 point | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| 3 points | 6 | 5 | 3 |
| 4 points | 8 | 6 | 4 |

For a Double Delivery Batch with a route credit of 2 points and an unreachable-customer credit of 1 point, the sum is 3; half of 3 is 1.5, rounded up to 2; the adjusted sum is 5 points.
